cypher: MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name
MATCH (n0:OrganizationRole) RETURN n0.person AS person, n0.title AS title

MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person)<-[:actor]-(n2:Commitment)-[:event]->(n3:Event) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker AND n2.action CONTAINS 'guest' AND n3.title CONTAINS 'launch' RETURN n3.requested_guest_limit AS requested_guest_limit

MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person)<-[:requested_by]-(n2:PersonalTask) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker AND n2.summary CONTAINS 'dinner' RETURN n2.requested_by AS requested_by, n2.assignee AS assignee, n2.requested_reservation_at_ms AS requested_reservation_at_ms
MATCH (n0:Person)<-[:assignee]-(n1:PersonalTask) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker AND n1.summary CONTAINS 'dinner' RETURN n1.assignee AS assignee, n1.confirmation_recorded AS confirmation_recorded
MATCH (n0:PurchaseOrder)<-[:order]-(n1:Invoice) WHERE n0.number = 'PO-60' RETURN n1.unit_price AS unit_price
MATCH (n0:PurchaseOrder) WHERE n0.number = 'PO-60' RETURN n0.estimated_dispatch_on AS estimated_dispatch_on
MATCH (n0:Pet)<-[:pet]-(n1:Appointment) WHERE n0.name = 'Fig' RETURN n1.scheduled_at_ms AS scheduled_at_ms
MATCH (n0:Pet)<-[:pet]-(n1:Appointment) WHERE n0.name = 'Fig' AND n1.purpose CONTAINS 'check' RETURN n1.attended AS attended, n1.diagnosis AS diagnosis
MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person)<-[:person]-(n2:OrganizationRole) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n2.organization AS organization, n2.title AS title
MATCH (n0:Person)-[:wife]->(n1:Person)-[:member]->(n2:Group) WHERE n0.name = 'Alex Chen' AND n2.name CONTAINS 'crew' RETURN n2.name AS name
